ambiguities: Rules v3 has no unresolved ambiguities in simulation. Interpretations used: Heat -3 floors the bonus at 0 (Heat on a messy +2 leaves 0); tiebreaker 2 counts all tricks including those on blown jobs; the role-pass direction (to the right) is equivalent to a fixed seat rotation; revokes are impossible; Heat on a 0 bonus does nothing; round 1 has no Heat (all tied); the Double-Crosser deal order has no effect on a random shuffle.
Targets 3-7 with crew tricks 0-7: Target 7 is a clean hit only on a sweep; legal, and rated as high-risk by the bots (success 69%).

problems.problem: Lead changes still below KPI (the only KPI miss).
problems.evidence: 1.61 lead changes per game vs target 2 (v2 1.49). Fallback experiments, 2,000 mirror games each: double-scored final round 1.84 (early leader 43%, but mixed-table strategic fell to 38.5% vs greedy 41.8%); crew loot on clean jobs only 1.64; critic's flat version 1.71 (greedy 48% vs strategic 36%). None reaches 2. Without Heat lead changes are 1.07, so Heat -3 is doing most of the work.
problems.fix: Accept 1.6-1.8 as a known soft miss (runaway leader is only 50%%, so games are not decided early), or ship double-scored final round as an optional finale. Untested: Heat on the sole leader also costs 1 loot; 7-round variants are not allowed by the rotation.

problems.problem: Strategic only ties greedy at the mixed table; skill lives mostly in beating random.
problems.evidence: Mixed table: greedy 41.8%, strategic (card-counting) 42.0%, random 16.2%. Skill gap vs random 46.1 pts (KPI 20), but greedy alone beats two randoms at 69.9% vs strategic 64.1%. v2: greedy 63.5% vs strategic 28.5% - the loot-on-success rule closed that gap fully.
problems.fix: None required for the KPI (strategic >= greedy within noise: +-1.1 pts). A human who can count cards and read the Double-Crosser should do better than the bot; confirm with a human playtest.

problems.problem: Target 3 is the most common bot choice and the least reliable; Targets 4-6 are the profitable band.
problems.evidence: Target 3 chosen 34% of rounds, success 28%; Target 6 chosen 14%, success 85%.
problems.fix: None; a sensible planner choice, not a dead option.

problems.problem: Games are low-scoring and Heat is on in most rounds.
problems.evidence: Mean final score 16.0 (rules.md predicted 18-28); Heat applies in 74% of rounds (holder averages 1.76 pts vs 2.67 round average).
problems.fix: Update the design-note scoring expectation to about 16; no rule change.
